resources.string: Minimum gap between two messages from this handset. Too fast and the carrier flags the SIM as bulk traffic and blocks it — which looks to users like login being broken. 6000 (6s) is a safe starting point.
Grant phone permission to list SIMs

Battery optimisation must be disabled, or Android will suspend the connection while the screen is off — the app keeps showing “Connected” and silently stops receiving work. Keep this handset on a charger.
